high: lib/rules.js:22 — secret-assign does not match quoted JSON/JS keys. The pattern requires the separator immediately after the name, so '{"token": "abcdef"}', '{"password": "hunter2"}' and '{"api_key": "abcd"}' all return []; unquoted token: "abcdef" does match. The prompt explicitly requires JSON to match. Add an optional closing quote before :/= (name["']?\s*[:=]) and a regression test; otherwise the most common serialized config form is missed by stage 3.
medium: lib/extract.js:332 (also :398) — <base href=/sub/> is valid unquoted HTML, but the trailing slash is treated as a self-closing marker and stripped: out.base='http://site.test/sub', relative 'after' -> 'http://site.test/after' instead of 'http://site.test/sub/after'. Quoted '/sub/' and unquoted '/sub/ ' work. Only strip a trailing slash when it is separated from the attribute value.

lib/extract.js:678,699-705,729,742-746 — the regex/division state machine still misclassifies valid JavaScript. 'var b = a++ / 2; var api="/api/v1/real";' and a-- variants return [] (link lost); 'of / 2' and 'x.return / 2' likewise; and a regex literal in statement position after if/while/for leaks regex-body strings: 'if (x) /"\/api\/v1\/fake"/.test(y); var api="/api/v1/real";' yields both /api/v1/fake and /api/v1/real. Track previous token type/statement position and add these cases.
low: lib/extract.js:270-287 — query-only <base href="?v=1"> is treated as a directory: out.base='http://site.test/dir/page.html/?v=1' and link 'after' -> 'http://site.test/dir/page.html/after' instead of /dir/after. Query-only base should keep the document's file-like path for resolution.

lib/extract.js:293-328 — firstBaseHref only skips comments, script and style; <base> inside <title>, <textarea> or <template> is treated as a real document base. Probe '<title><base href="/x/"></title><a href="after">' -> base /x/ and link /x/after; markup in RCDATA/template content is inert.

tests/rules.test.js:138-156 and tests/extract.test.js:193-235 — new tests cover the repaired cases but not JSON quoted-key secrets, max_tokens/secretCount/api_key_id false positives, unquoted <base href=/sub/>, or postfix division. The worker reports probe these, but the suite does not lock them in.
